e: From MGRI + -ite, from an initialism used for the Moscow Institute of Geological Exploration.
q: Dimorpheous minerals like bellidoite and berzelianite are as much indistinguishable like intergrowths of the minerals berzelianite, mgriite and lollingite using backscattered and secondary electron images. Optical microscopy is the key to overcome these problems.
2007, T. Schlothauer, A. D. Renno, G. Heide, Keeping Track of the Selenide Zoo:
